about: Issuer description patterns (SPEC 'Files, paths and settings' > Reference data in the repo).
Reference data only: issuer wording, never a person's name, an account number or an amount.
Each wording is matched against a line's description_norm (casefolded, whitespace collapsed),
as a whole-token run: a match never starts or ends inside a word. Every part of 'all' must
match and no part of 'unless' may. 'issuers' and 'account_kinds', when present, limit an entry
to lines of those issuer keys and account kinds. In each section the first matching entry wins.
A reversal entry with direction 'sign' names no direction: the line's sign settles it (a credit is 'out').
A counterpart is an issuer key from the archive's issuer map (rheo_finance.documents.issuers).
